page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number at left; heading title below it in large type; a woodcut emblem engraving in the centre; below it a four-line verse in italic; a small note "Alludit" at lower right.

main_text.l: Sola Dei pietas vitarum stamina ducit,
Quare cum veluti filum sit vita caducum,
Ad momenta vide singula, teqs; para.

page.notes: The engraving shows a seated woman with an hourglass on her head, holding a distaff, and a skeleton standing to the right holding an hourglass and a dart; a town with a harbour appears in the background between two shell-topped columns. The title is set in large italic capitals with "ta hora" in italic lowercase on the second line. "Alludit" is a small note at lower right, set apart from the verse. Two lines of the verse end in a printed mark ("caducum;" and "teqs;") which are reproduced as printed.
